name: World State
description: Tracks location, date, time, weather, and temperature across the scene. Renders a compact HUD bar at the top of each message. Runs as a separate post-gen analysis call.
prompt:
### World State — Post-Generation Tracker
Analyze the scene that just played out and determine the current world state.

Output exactly one tag:

[WORLD|Location|Date|Time|Weather|Temperature]

Field guide:
- Location: Where the scene is happening. Be specific and use the proper name — "The Rusty Flagon" not "a tavern", "Katsura River Bridge" not "outside".
- Date: In-world date, using whatever calendar the setting uses. If no calendar exists yet, use a natural format.
- Time: Formatted as HH:MM AM/PM — e.g. 09:00 PM, 02:15 PM, 06:30 AM.
- Weather: Pick ONE from this list:
  Clear, Sunny, Partly Cloudy, Overcast, Cloudy, Light Rain, Rain, Drizzle, Heavy Rain, Downpour, Thunderstorm, Storm, Snow, Light Snow, Heavy Snow, Blizzard, Fog, Mist, Haze, Windy, Breezy, Clear Night, Moonlit Night, Starry, Hail, Sleet
- Temperature: Pick ONE — Freezing, Cold, Cool, Mild, Warm, Hot, Scorching.

Rules:
- Output ONLY the [WORLD|...|...|...|...|...] tag. Nothing else — no prose, no explanation, no commentary.
- PRESERVE CONTINUITY. Only modify what the narrative changes.
- ADVANCE TIME logically. Walking across a city = time passes. A long conversation = time passes. A scene break may skip hours. Time should never stay identical between messages unless the scene is very brief.
- INFER SENSIBLE DEFAULTS from genre, setting, and context when the narrative hasn't specified something.
- Base your analysis on what actually happened in the scene — do not invent details not supported by the text.

mergeVariable.formatHeader: Current world state (preserve continuity — only change what the narrative changes):
mergeVariable.formatEmpty: No world state established yet. Infer sensible defaults from the setting.
